facts: Key benchmarks: $90^{\circ}$ (right angle), $180^{\circ}$ (straight), $45^{\circ}$ (half a right angle), $360^{\circ}$ (full turn).
Smaller than the square corner $\Rightarrow$ less than $90^{\circ}$; wider $\Rightarrow$ more.
A good estimate is usually within about $10^{\circ}$ of the true value.
steps: Compare the angle with the nearest benchmark.
Decide if it is a bit more or a bit less.

foundation.question_text:
Estimate the marked angle using $45^{\circ}$ and $90^{\circ}$ as benchmarks.
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large}]\usetikzlibrary{angles}\coordinate(V)at(0,0);\coordinate(A)at(4,0);\coordinate(B)at(42:4);\draw(A)--(V)--(B);\pic[draw,angle radius=0.7cm]{angle=A--V--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
foundation.solution_text:
The angle is a little less than $45^{\circ}$.
A sensible estimate is about $40^{\circ}$.

foundation.question_text:
Estimate this narrow angle.
Is $10^{\circ}$, $45^{\circ}$ or $85^{\circ}$ most sensible?
[tikz]
\begin{tikzpicture}[every node/.style={font=\large}]\usetikzlibrary{angles}\coordinate(V)at(0,0);\coordinate(A)at(4,0);\coordinate(B)at(14:4);\draw(A)--(V)--(B);\pic[draw,angle radius=0.9cm]{angle=A--V--B};\end{tikzpicture}
[/tikz]
foundation.solution_text:
The arms are much closer than half a right angle.
The most sensible estimate is $10^{\circ}$.

development.question_text:

development.question_text:
An angle looks a little less than half a right angle.
Which estimate is more sensible: $35^{\circ}$ or $75^{\circ}$?
development.solution_text: Half a right angle is $45^{\circ}$. A little less is close to $35^{\circ}$, not $75^{\circ}$.

mastery.question_text:
A learner estimates an angle just wider than a right angle as $170^{\circ}$.
Explain why this is unreasonable and improve it.
mastery.solution_text: $170^{\circ}$ is close to a straight angle. Just wider than $90^{\circ}$ would be about $100^{\circ}$ or $110^{\circ}$.

mastery.question_text:
A reflex angle leaves a small inside angle of about $40^{\circ}$.
Estimate the reflex angle.

Two estimates for the same angle are $82^{\circ}$ and $128^{\circ}$.
The angle is visibly a little smaller than a right angle.
Which estimate is reasonable?
mastery.solution_text: A little smaller than $90^{\circ}$ matches $82^{\circ}$. The $128^{\circ}$ estimate is too wide.
